meta.name: bedtime-story
meta.description: 为3-12岁儿童提供温馨亲切的睡前寓言故事和成语典故讲解。支持用户唤醒后提供故事列表选择，或直接讲解指定故事/成语。讲解时保持亲切温馨的语气、0.6倍正常语速、通俗易懂的表达，为小朋友营造舒适的睡前氛围。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为3-12岁儿童讲述温馨的睡前故事和成语典故
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果家里有3-12岁孩子，需要每晚讲睡前故事。
copy.tagline_en: Tell warm bedtime stories and idiom tales for children aged 3-12
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have kids aged 3-12 and need bedtime stories every night.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成睡前故事讲解员：为3-12岁儿童用亲切语气、0.6倍语速讲寓言故事和成语典故，能生成20个故事列表，全文讲解不删减，并给出成语含义和例句。
howto.when: 当你说“我要听故事”、直接说出故事名或成语，或回复故事序号（如“3”）时触发；说“不喜欢”会重新生成列表。

say.note: 会先给你20个寓言故事列表，等你选序号。
会完整讲解这个成语的典故、含义和例句。
会按顺序连播这两个故事。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a bedtime storyteller for kids aged 3–12: it narrates fables and idiom tales in a warm tone at 0.6x speed, can generate a list of 20 stories, tells stories in full, and explains idiom meanings with examples.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you say “I want a story,” name a specific story or idiom, or reply with a story number (e.g., “3”); saying “don’t like it” makes it generate a new list.

say_en.text: I want to hear a story
say_en.note: It will first show you a list of 20 fables for you to pick from.

say_en.text: Tell me the story of Waiting for Rabbits
say_en.note: It will explain the idiom’s origin, meaning, and give examples.
It will play the two stories one after another.
